name: Emoji & Icon Studio by Kairesh
releaseNotes:
v2.8.4 Single-Item Drop, Auto-Organized 'Icons' Bin & Local Folder Sync!
• Single-Item Timeline Drop: Fixed duplicate file drops in Premiere Pro timeline — dragging drops exactly 1 clip cleanly onto your sequence!
• Auto-Organized 'Icons' Bin: Dropped or inserted assets are automatically organized into an 'Icons' bin in Premiere Pro and After Effects project panels!
• Local 'Icons' Folder: Automatically creates and saves all assets into an 'Icons' folder inside your selected/linked folder on disk!
• Clear All Recents: Dedicated one-click button in Recents toolbar to easily clear all recent history.
• Real-Time Folder Sync: Live updates when adding or removing items from local folders in Windows Explorer.
